figures.caption: Fig. 1. Overview of CADRE. A frozen BiomedCLIP (ViT-B/16) encoder is adapted sequentially over dissimilar modalities (histopathology → ultrasound → · · · → radiography) via visual-encoder LoRA (≈0.23% of parameters) and a linear head, regularized by three stability mechanisms: (1) online self-scaling EWC over a sum-normalised running Fisher; (2) similarity-aware retention relaxing consolidation for dissimilar modalities; (3) evaluation-time EMA weight averaging with light label smoothing. The anchor penalty Lanchor = ∥gLoRA − gfrozen∥2 bounds embedding drift from the frozen prior.

Table 1. Main comparison: cross-modality continual adaptation (mean±SEM, 3 seeds × 2 orders). Lower forgetting better; higher Acc/AUROC/SPQ/BWT better. Best per column among comparison methods in bold; CADRE−anchor is a controlled ablation, set apart.
